title: Razorpay, Sembcorp Green Infra get Sebi nod to float IPOs

title: India's forex reserves rise by $2.49 billion to $719.55 billion: RBI data
excerpt:
India's forex reserves increased by USD 2.49 billion to USD 719.547 billion during the week ended November 6, according to the RBI data released on Friday.
In the previous week, the forex reserves had dropped by USD 2.691 billion to USD 717.056 billion.
The reserves had touched an all-time high of USD 785.706 billion during the week ended September 4, driven by a heavy flow of currency as part of a special concessional swap for deposits from the diaspora through which banks raised a record USD 133 billion, but had been on a decline ever since.
During the week ended November 6, foreign currency assets, a major component of reserves, increased by USD 232 million to USD 591.350 billion…

title: How US tech pain is European stock markets' gain
excerpt: European stock markets, particularly the STOXX 600, are performing well as tech turmoil affects global markets. This relative stability is attributed to Europe's lower exposure to tech giants compared to the US market. Companies in sectors such as energy and financials are supporting earnings growth, which is on track for 25% quarterly profit. title: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
